summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a September 10, 2026 letter agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. completing the second closing of a $5,000,000 convertible debenture under a July 20, 2026 securities purchase agreement. The filing also amends the February 2026 $20,000,000 promissory note, related warrants and outstanding debentures. No cash proceeds were received at the second closing; the transaction is a routine financing arrangement reported under Items 1.01, 2.03, 3.02 and 9.01, not a special situation.
